SELECT ra.id, ra.recruitment_id as recruitmentId, ra.user_id as userId, COALESCE(u.real_name, u.username) as userName, u.phone, u.email, ra.status, ra.remark, ra.skills, ra.experience, ra.created_time as createdTime, ra.updated_time as updatedTime, ra.review_time as reviewTime, ra.review_remark as reviewRemark, ra.deleted FROM recruitment_admission ra LEFT JOIN volunteer_user u ON ra.user_id = u.id WHERE ra.recruitment_id = #{recruitmentId} AND ra.deleted = 0
AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%'))
AND u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
AND ra.status = #{status}
ORDER BY ra.created_time DESC
